Rates and assumptions used
New regime: nil up to ₹4 lakh; 5% to ₹8L; 10% to ₹12L; 15% to ₹16L; 20% to ₹20L; 25% to ₹24L; 30% above. Standard deduction ₹75,000. Rebate up to ₹60,000 when taxable income is ₹12 lakh or less, with marginal relief just above it.

Old regime: nil up to ₹2.5 lakh; 5% to ₹5L; 20% to ₹10L; 30% above. Standard deduction ₹50,000. Rebate up to ₹12,500 when taxable income is ₹5 lakh or less.

Health & education cess 4% on the tax. Budget 2026 left these rates unchanged for FY 2026-27; the Income-tax Act 2025 applies from 1 April 2026 with the same rates and renumbered sections.

Assumes a resident individual below 60, with salary as the main income. Surcharge (above ₹50 lakh), senior-citizen slabs, capital gains, and Section 89(1) relief are not modelled. Your employer's actual TDS may differ slightly — check the tax statement your DDO issues (Form 130 from FY 2026-27, earlier called Form 16).

Saves the April–March statement, Form 16-style gross and both tax workings as a PDF.

Pay Fixation Wizard

Rule 12 method (J&K Civil Service (Revised) Pay Rules, 2018 / SRO-193 of 2018) — one notional increment in your current level, then placement at the equal-or-next-higher stage in the new level — run against the official J&K pay matrix. ESTIMATE confirm against the actual order governing your case.

All four are fixed the same way under Rule 12 — they differ in who is eligible and when, not in the fixation formula itself.

Statutory pay fixation steps

Rule 13 option — from promotion or from DNI?

Rule 13 lets you choose to have pay fixed from the date of promotion, or from your next increment date (DNI) in the level you're being promoted from. ESTIMATE

Option A — fixed from promotion date (permanent)₹0
Option B — interim, promotion date → DNI₹0
Option B — final, from DNI onward (permanent)₹0
First increment in new level — Option A—
First increment in new level — Option B—

Under Option B you don't wait unpaid — you draw the interim figure in real time from the promotion date to your DNI (it's lower than Option A because it carries no notional increment, that credit is saved for DNI). At DNI, two increments land together (one annual, one for the promotion), pushing you to a higher figure than Option A gets — permanently, for the rest of your service in this level. There's no arrears owed for the interim window itself; arrears only arise separately if the order is actually issued/paid later than its effective date (see the Arrears card below). Under Option B the first increment in the new level comes six months after the DNI fixation (Finance Department O.M. of 7 Feb 2020), so your increment month can change — see Orders.

Assumes DA and HRA stayed at the rates above for the whole period. If a DA revision fell in the middle of it, split the period at that date and add the two parts together for a more accurate figure. Note: Rule 16 of SRO-193 technically defines "arrears of pay" as the Basic+DA difference only — the HRA portion above is real money too, but isn't part of that official arrears definition.

Gratuity Calculator

Retirement gratuity for government employees. ESTIMATE

Formula: (Basic + DA) × completed 6-month periods of service ÷ 4, capped at 16.5× (Basic+DA) or the ceiling above — whichever is lower. The ceiling is revised periodically; confirm the current figure with your DDO.

Government Orders

DA, HRA, promotion, pay, pension and SLI orders that affect J&K employees — each with a plain-language explanation and your own numbers. Curated and checked on ; this is not a live feed. READ THE ORDER BEFORE ACTING

Year-wise order archive

Filter the records catalogued in this app by issue year. For every other historical year, search the official Government of J&K archive. Each record offers an attached PDF only when the actual file is embedded or a verified direct PDF link is available.

Official GAD ArchiveSearch official orders / SROs

A PDF is marked attached only when its file is embedded. Direct official PDF links are labeled separately; other records provide an official archive lookup, not a fake attachment.

How this list is kept

Entries come from official documents shared with the app (marked on each card) and from J&K Finance Department and Union Cabinet decisions as reported by news outlets. Where only press reports exist, the card says so and gives no order number it could not confirm. The official place for J&K service orders is the General Administration Department site, jkgad.nic.in.

Statuses: IN FORCE — current order. ACTION BY DATE — has a deadline. AWAITED — expected but not issued, so any figure is a projection. REFERENCE — older rules this app's calculators are built on; later amendments may exist. Missing an order? Send it to the app owner to add.

Search Rules

The service rules and regulations that govern J&K employees — pay, pension, leave, service, conduct and recruitment — in plain language, with the SRO / S.O. / O.M. numbers they come from. Curated and checked on ; a summary, not the legal text. READ THE RULE BEFORE ACTING

Year-wise rules archive

Filter rules catalogued in this app by year. Historical rules not yet catalogued are not automatically downloaded into the app; use the official archive to locate their original PDFs. Each entry links to an official PDF only when a verified direct PDF URL is available.

Official GAD ArchiveSearch official orders / SROs

Embedded PDFs, verified direct PDF links, official record pages, and app-written summaries are explicitly distinguished.

How this library is kept

Each entry paraphrases an official rule, regulation or notification and gives its reference number only where it was confirmed from the document or an official listing. Rules are amended often — an entry marked AMENDED has been changed since it was first made, so read the current text. Press reports are named as such. The official place for J&K service orders is the General Administration Department site, jkgad.nic.in, and the Finance Department publishes the SROs.

Not covered yet: Central Government rules, and rules specific to a single department or cadre. Missing a rule? Send it to the app owner to add.

Employee Toolkit

Personal service records, increment planning, arrears estimates, deadline reminders, draft applications and secure local backup. Information is stored in this browser unless you export it.

Service BookIncrement TrackerArrearsLettersBackup

1. Digital Service Book

Enter details from your official service book/orders. This is a personal reference record, not an official service book.

2. Increment & Promotion Tracker

Tracks dates and your own eligibility notes. It does not determine legal eligibility; confirm qualifying service and conditions from the applicable rules and department.

3. Salary Arrears Estimator

A simple gross-difference estimate only. It does not calculate tax, NPS, DA changes by month, interest, or legal entitlement.

Estimated gross arrears₹0

Formula: (revised monthly gross − old monthly gross) × months.

4. Deadline & Follow-up Tracker

Record an application, option-form or document deadline. Browser reminders are only available while this app is open unless a separate push service is deployed.

5. Application & Letter Draft Generator

Creates an editable draft only. Check the facts, add recipient details, and verify the applicable order before submission.

6. Searchable PDF & Official Order Library

Search the app's curated summaries and the live official index. Original PDF buttons appear only when an actual PDF URL is available; a record page is not the same as an attached PDF.

Official GAD archiveOfficial order / SRO search

7. Backup & Restore

Export this app's GovPay 360 localStorage records to a JSON backup file, or restore a backup you previously exported. Keep the file private: it may contain salary and service information.

Privacy noteService records and tracker entries are stored in this browser on this device. They are not official records and are not automatically synced to another device. Do not use this as the only copy of important documents.
